title: 'This is your last chance': SC ultimatum to govt over front pack warning labels
content: The Supreme Court has expressed strong disapproval towards the government's procrastination regarding food warning labels, specifically calling out the FSSAI. The justices mandated that the Centre has a fortnight to cement its decision, prioritizing public health, particularly for children. The court dismissed claims surrounding traditional foods and foreign standards, signaling that judicial actions could follow if a definitive choice remains absent.

title: 'Can't play both': India withdraw from FIFA ASEAN Cup to prioritise Brazil clash
content: "We have pulled out of the FIFA ASEAN Cup since we can't play both Brazil and FIFA ASEAN Cup," Satyanarayanan was quoted as saying by PTI.

title: Google co-founder’s a message for DeepMind staff after Demis Hassabis exits as CEO
content: Google co-founder Sergey Brin has been urging Google DeepMind staff to go all in on Gemini and catch up to the AI frontier, following a sweeping leadership overhaul that saw Demis Hassabis step aside as CEO. Koray Kavukcuoglu now runs day-to-day operations from Mountain View, with final say on major decisions. The reshuffle follows Gemini release delays, coding benchmark gaps against Anthropic and OpenAI, and high-profile exits including Jeff Dean.

title: 'Lot of things will get solved': Harbhajan Singh picks Sreesanth as 'roommate'

This came after Sreesanth threw down a boxing gauntlet to Harbhajan, sparked by an image of their former rivalry. Their relationship traces back to a tumultuous 2008 IPL incident that has left lingering tensions.

title: Bengal strips BJP MP Ananta Maharaj of state honour over remarks 'insulting' Netaji
content: In a significant move, the West Bengal government has rescinded the Banga Bibhushan award granted to Ananta Maharaj. This decision arose from his controversial comments questioning Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose’s leadership and the establishment of the Azad Hind Fauj. The remarks have sparked strong backlash from various political factions and groups, underscoring the deep emotions tied to the legacy of this revered freedom fighter.

title: Indian IT sector job market is changing: What can get you hired & at a premium
content: Experts believe that the era of broad-based recruitment and hefty pay hikes in the Indian IT sector is over. Companies are now tightening hiring at the entry level, while at the same time competing to get experienced professionals in select areas.

title: Months after Dells' $6.25bn ‘gift’, US Treasury sets new Trump Account paycheck rules
content: Under the new guidelines for Trump Accounts, both employers and employees can make contributions towards payrolls. Employers are permitted to add up to $2,500 annually without tax for dependent children, while employees can contribute pre-tax funds directly from their paychecks. In support of this initiative, Michael and Susan Dell committed $6.25 billion to boost child savings. The proposal is currently open for public feedback prior to its finalization.

title: Inside the veteran actor's serene Mumbai home with greenery and minimalist interiors
content: Zeenat Aman has spent decades in the spotlight, but away from films and public appearances, she prefers a quieter way of life at her Mumbai home. The residence, filled with greenery, floral accents and minimalist design, reflects the veteran actor's understated personality and her deep connection with nature and family.

title: Meet Carmela, 11, the youngest person ever awarded an MBE
content: Carmela Chillery-Watson became the youngest MBE recipient at eleven years old. She received the honour for her extensive fundraising and awareness work. This recognition celebrated her dedication to Muscular Dystrophy UK and the disabled community. Carmela's journey began after her diagnosis with a rare muscle-wasting condition at age four. Her continued advocacy aims to promote accessibility and support for those affected.

title: Buffalo extends emerald shiner passage along 700 feet of Niagara River seawall
content: The city of Buffalo is enhancing a fish passageway to facilitate the journey of emerald shiners to Lake Erie. By installing steel baffles along the seawall, this initiative aims to mitigate strong currents. This effort is part of a significant multi-million-dollar restoration project for the Niagara River Area, alongside transforming nearby industrial slips into crucial shallow-water habitats, all geared towards rectifying historic environmental harm in western New York.

title: Jeff Bezos may be buying house in Beverly Hills: Why this billionaire buy is ‘odd’
content: Amazon founder Jeff Bezos is reportedly buying a Beverly Hills condo.  This luxury residence is expected to be the most expensive ever sold.  The six-bedroom penthouse spans seventeen thousand square feet and includes many amenities.  It is located in the soon-to-open Aman complex, which will offer hotel services.  The deal remains unconfirmed by the developer or a source close to Bezos.

title: 'Sorry for the pain': Australian cricketer breaks silence on cheating allegations
content: Australian cricket vice-captain Ashleigh Gardner has openly shared her emotions regarding the recent end of her relationship with Monica Wright. In her statement, she offered sincere apologies for the distress caused and confirmed that Cricket Australia fully supports her ongoing role. Gardner reflected with gratitude on their time together and conveyed her best wishes for Wright, requesting space for both of them to navigate this situation privately.

title: Watch: When gunman tried to assassinate Sukhbir Badal at Golden Temple in 2024
content: Sukhbir Singh Badal survived a harrowing second assassination attempt at the Golden Temple, where he was observing a religious ritual amidst allegations of misconduct. Quick-thinking volunteers sprang into action, deflecting the gunman's aim, causing the shot to fire harmlessly into the air. Fortunately, the attacker was swiftly arrested, raising serious questions about security measures at this revered Sikh site.

title: Badal attacked with kirpan; cop hurt intervening: How assassination bid unfolded
content: Shiromani Akali Dal president Sukhbir Singh Badal was attacked with a kirpan at a Nanded gurdwara. A police inspector sustained injuries while protecting Badal during the religious visit. Badal suffered a hand injury and was taken for medical treatment. Security personnel intervened and overpowered the attacker at the scene. Police have launched an investigation into the motive and circumstances of the incident.

title: Bob Iger & Josh Kushner: The Duo Behind Lakers’ $12.5B Takeover
content: Bob Iger and Josh Kushner have agreed to buy the Los Angeles Lakers from Mark Walter for a record $12.5 billion, just 14 months after Walter purchased the team at a $10 billion valuation. The sale comes amid reported federal scrutiny of Walter's business holdings. Iger, former Disney CEO, and Kushner, founder of Thrive Capital, bring entertainment and venture capital expertise to a franchise now navigating its second ownership change in barely a year, with Luka Dončić and the roster awaiting clarity on what comes next.

title: Luka Doncic gets heartfelt two-word reaction from Lakers boss after deal
content: Lakers governor Jeanie Buss responded to Luka Doncic's statement on the team's pending sale with a two-word endorsement on X. The reaction comes as Josh Kushner and Bob Iger move to buy the franchise for $12.5 billion, roughly 14 months after Mark Walter acquired it from the Buss family. Doncic, now the Lakers' central figure following LeBron James' departure, said he remains committed to winning a title in Los Angeles under the incoming ownership group.

title: Lived in gurdwara for 2 yrs: What we know about Nihang Sikh who attacked Badal

Fortunately, security personnel quickly intervened to subdue the attacker, who had been living at the gurdwara for two years. Badal suffered a hand injury and received necessary medical care, while a security inspector was also injured.

title: She was just 3km from home: B'luru keeps fixing roads, yet they keep turning deadly

Despite ongoing attempts to repair the extensive pothole issue, the roads are frequently excavated for utility repairs, leading to further damage. This troubling cycle poses daily risks to commuters, emphasizing the urgent need for better coordination and accountability in road maintenance and safety measures.

title: How JJ Watt went from CBS backup to threatening Tony Romo’s $180mn TV future

Watt has been promoted to join Jim Nantz in the top broadcasting team. He will now embark on a carefully planned rehabilitation program supervised by medical professionals to aid his recovery. The hospital reassured that Jr NTR is recovering well. He expressed heartfelt thanks to his fans for their continuous support, with doctors optimistic about his full recovery within two to three months.

Several international manufacturers are competing to supply these vital new aircraft. The new planes will enhance India's strategic and tactical airlift capabilities significantly. This modernization will also bolster disaster relief and humanitarian aid operations.

title: India's trade deficit widens 31.5% to $15bn in July; electronics exports surge 11-fold
content: In July, India faced a significant expansion in its trade deficit, as imports surged ahead of exports. Over the first four months of the fiscal year, cumulative trade gaps widened considerably. Nevertheless, merchandise exports reached impressive heights in July, with electronics manufacturing emerging as a crucial growth sector. Additionally, the rise in mobile phone production and exports contributed to significant employment opportunities.

title: Mitchell Starc scripts history, breaks all-time left-arm Test record

He claimed his 434th Test wicket, overtaking Rangana Herath, while equaling Kapil Dev’s tally in fewer matches. title: The journey of Trapit Bansal, the IITian behind Meta’s big AI offer

His journey includes advanced studies at IISc and the University of Massachusetts Amherst, research internships at Facebook, Google, Microsoft and OpenAI, and work on reinforcement learning and reasoning models at OpenAI. Now a founding researcher at Meta’s AI division, Bansal’s story highlights how years of specialised education and research can build extraordinary expertise.

The body has been sent for post-mortem examination.
